SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. L. Q. D. 1187
Date..9....5.. 30

May 9, 30.

Confidential.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter of March 17, 1930, concerning the
activities of John Kerr alias L. U. Baird alias
Craster etc., etc. in connection with issue of false
bills of lading, and beg to forward herewith for
your information a summary of the results obtained
in investigations made by the Police in Shanghai.

No action, however, is expected to be taken
by the firms locally, who are involved in these
frauds.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient servant,

Dea

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches).

Mr. Jaquillard,
Chief of Police,
i/c Criminal Investigation Department.
Canton of Vaud,
Switzerland.

先生，

谨此确认收到您1930年3月17日的来信，内容涉及 John Kerr（又名 L. U. Baird，又名 Craster 等）签发虚假提单的活动，并随函附上上海警方调查结果摘要，供您参考。

然而，预计卷入这些欺诈案的本地公司不会采取任何行动。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

Dea

副总监

Jaquillard 先生，

沃州，

page_data.en:
SUMMARY.
------------

Early in 1928 the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank,
No. 9 Ningpo Road, had correspondence with their agents,
Guaranty Trust Company of New York, 32 Lombard Street,London,
advising them that money had been drawn by "C. J. Kerr of
Luxembourg" against forged Bills of Lading under their
authority to purchase. The Shanghai Commercial Savings Bank
received a letter from their London agents, dated March 7th 1930,
informing them that they had handed over to the London Police
all necessary papers and documents verifying amount lost by
them in anticipation of Kerr's trial in Switzerland. The actual
amount fraudulently obtained by Kerr from the Shanghai
Commercial and Savings Bank cannot be given by their authorities
here as all official papers were with their London agents.

On February 14th 1928 a Bank Draft for £500 on behalf of
the Yue Tah Company, General Paper Merchants, P.O. 2768A,Haining
Road, was passed through the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking
Corporation, No. 12 The Bund, Shanghai, to the latter's agents
in London for "C.J. Kerr, Luxembourg". Luckily Yue Tah Company
on March 11th 1928 discovered Kerr's Bills of Lading were
forgeries, and, therefore asked the Hongkong and Shanghai
Banking Corporation at Shanghai to cable their agents in London
to cancel the £500 Bank Draft, which was done. The only loss
suffered by the Yue Tah Company was the cabling expenses.

On January 4th 1928 the Wah Chang Trading Corporation
Nos. 8/9 Ningpo Road, against a contract for paper from
"C.J. Kerr Luxembourg", valued at £709-15-10, forwarded a
draft for £709-15- through the Shanghai Commercial Savings
Bank, No. 9 Ningpo Road, which the latter Bank transferred
to their agents, The Guaranty Trust Company of New York,
32 Lombard Street, London, to be drawn by "C.J. Kerr". "Kerr"
collected this amount on January 28th 1928 from the Guaranty
page_data.zh:
摘要。
------------

1928年初，位于宁波路9号的上海商业储蓄银行与其代理人、位于伦敦伦巴第街32号的纽约担保信托公司（Guaranty Trust Company of New York）通信，告知他们，“卢森堡的 C. J. Kerr”在其授权下凭伪造提单提取了款项用于购买。上海商业储蓄银行收到其伦敦代理人1930年3月7日的来信，通知他们已将核实损失金额所需的所有必要文件和单据移交给伦敦警方，以备 Kerr 在瑞士受审之用。由于所有官方文件均在伦敦代理人处，上海方面当局无法提供 Kerr 从上海商业储蓄银行诈骗的具体金额。

1928年2月14日，一张代表海宁路邮政信箱2768A号通用纸张商 Yue Tah Company（音译：悦达公司）的500英镑银行汇票，经由上海外滩12号的汇丰银行（Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation）转至其在伦敦的代理人，收款人为“卢森堡的 C.J. Kerr”。幸运的是，Yue Tah Company 于1928年3月11日发现 Kerr 的提单系伪造，因此要求上海汇丰银行电告其伦敦代理人取消该张500英镑的银行汇票，此举得以执行。Yue Tah Company 遭受的唯一损失是电报费。

1928年1月4日，华昌贸易公司（Wah Chang Trading Corporation，宁波路8/9号）根据与“卢森堡的 C.J. Kerr”签订的价值为709英镑15先令10便士的纸张合同，通过宁波路9号的上海商业储蓄银行汇出了一张709英镑15先令的汇票，该行随后将汇票转至其代理人、位于伦敦伦巴第街32号的纽约担保信托公司，由“C.J. Kerr”提取。“Kerr”于1928年1月28日从纽约担保信托公司提取了这笔款项，不久之后，华昌贸易公司意识到来自“卢森堡的 C.J. Kerr”的货物提单系伪造。

Trust Company of New York, and it was shortly after this
that the Wah Chang Trading Company realised that the
Bills of Lading for the cargo from "C.J. Kerr Luxembourg"
were forgeries.
"C.J. Kerr Luxembourg" forwarded in July 1927 to the Tah Tai
Shing Company, Nos. 2656/7 East Seward Road, a circular
with enticing prices for paper. This company did not deal
in this particular article, therefore forwarded the circular
to the Wha Chang Shun Company, No. 6 The Bund, which concern,
encouraged by the prices, contracted two orders with Kerr,
between 1927 and 1928 to the value of £1769-19-2. Two Bank
Drafts were forwarded by the latter company to cover the
amount through the Chekiang Industrial Bank, Shanghai, and the
Shanghai Commercial Savings Bank, Shanghai, respectively.
Both banks forwarded the drafts to their respective agents,
the National Provincial Bank London and the Guaranty Trust
Company of New York London. "C.J. Kerr" drew the drafts
from London before the Wha Chang Shun Company realised that
the Bills of Lading in connection with orders were forgeries.
No action is required to be taken in Shanghai in
connection with aforementioned cases, because the firms
who have suffered losses realise that they will not recover
the money lost, and are content with the action which is
being taken against the culprit in Switzerland.

信托公司提取了这笔款项，不久之后，华昌贸易公司意识到来自“卢森堡的 C.J. Kerr”的货物提单系伪造。
“卢森堡的 C.J. Kerr”于1927年7月向东瑟瓦德路2656/7号的 Tah Tai Shing Company（音译：泰泰兴公司）发送了一份印有诱人纸张价格的通告。该公司不经营此类商品，因此将通告转交给了外滩6号的 Wha Chang Shun Company（音译：华昌顺公司），该公司受价格吸引，于1927年至1928年间与 Kerr 签订了两笔订单，价值共计1769英镑19先令2便士。后者公司分别通过上海浙江实业银行和上海商业储蓄银行汇出了两张银行汇票以支付款项。两家银行分别将汇票转至其各自的代理人，即伦敦的国家省立银行（National Provincial Bank London）和伦敦的纽约担保信托公司。“C. J. Kerr”在 Wha Chang Shun Company 意识到与订单相关的提单系伪造之前，已在伦敦提取了汇票款项。
鉴于上述案件，上海方面无需采取行动，因为遭受损失的公司意识到无法追回损失款项，并对瑞士方面针对罪犯采取的行动表示满意。

H.Q. C.B.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No.

With reference to the attached file I. C.D.II87.

Sir,
Mr T. C. Tsiang, assistant manager of the Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank, No 9 Ningpo Road, was interviewed by the undersigned at about 11a.m on April 25th 1930. He stated that the bank had lost money on forged bills of lading in connection with Mr C. J. Kerr of Luxemberg but could not say how much as all the documents and papers have been forwarded to the "Guranty Trust Co" No 32 Lombard Street. London. Mr Tsiang then produced copies of 2 letters which he had received, one was from the "Guranty Trust Co" and the other from a friend of his in Hamburg. (Herewith attached) Mr Tsiang also stated that he had heard that the Chekiang Industrial Bank. No 13 Hankow Road and the Hongkong Shanghai Bank. No 12 Bund had also lost money on forged bills of lading.

Mr Z. H. Kung assistant manager of the Foreign Section of the Chekiang Industrial Bank, No 13 Hankow Road, was interviewed at the bank by the undersigned at about 2-30 p.m. on April 25th, 1930, where he produced a credit note for £712-10-0 for account of the "Wha Chang Shun Co" No 6 Bund in favor of Mr C. J. Kerr of Luxemberg on October 13th 1927. ( Copy of credit note herewith attached) The Chekiang Industrial Bank did not suffer any loss.

Acting on Mr T.C.Tsiang's information, Mr Beatty, accountant at the Hongkong Shanghai Bank No 12 Bund was interviewed at about 3-15 p.m. on April 25th 1930, where he produced a bank draft for £ 500-0-0 for the"Yue Tah Co" No P.D. 2768a Haining Road in favor of Mr C. J. Kerr of Luxemberg on February 14th 1928. ( Copy of draft order herewith attached)

At about 8-45a.m. on April 26th 1930, enquiries were made at the "Yue Tah Co" at No P.D. 2768a Haining Road, where information was received, that the manager a Mr Wong could only be interviewed at the "Cosmos Paper Co" at No 33 Kiangse Road as he is the compradore there. Mr Wong was later interviewed at about 11a.m on April 26th 1930, at the "Cosmos Paper Co", where he stated that he had only suffered a loss of the small cable fees, as their orders in connection with the "Yue Tah Co" and Mr C.J. Kerr were cancelled in time to prevent any loss, and that the bank draft for £500-0-0 that they had cabled to Mr C.J.Kerr, had been cancelled.
A letter from the "Yue Tah Co" is herewith attached which gives account of their business transactions with Mr Kerr.

At about 10-20a.m on April 26th 1930, Mr Chau Jen Zar manager of the "Wha Chang Shun Co" No 6 Bund, was interviewed where he stated that his losses in connection with Mr C.J.Kerr were about £1770-0-0, in 1927 & 1928. Mr Chau then produced orders and correspondence in connection with business with Mr Kerr,which began through a circular letter which was sent to"Tah Tai Shing" No 2656/7 East Seward Road in 1927, by Mr C.J.Kerr and handed to Mr Chau Jen Zar,as " Tah Tai Shing" did not deal in paper.(Attached is copies of orders and correspondence between the "Wha Chang Shun Co" and Mr Kerr.

Acting on Mr Chau Jen Zar's information, Mr K.Y.Liu, assistant manager of the "Wah Chang Trading Corporation, No 9 Ningpo Road was interviewed at about 10- 45a.m on April 26th 1930, where he stated that the company's losses in connection with business with Mr C.J.Kerr in 1927 & 1928 was about £709-15-0. Copies of some of the orders and correspondence are herewith attached.

总部 C.B.
(刑事侦缉处) 办公笔记
档案编号

关于所附档案 I. C.D.II87。

先生，
1930年4月25日上午11时许，签署人约谈了宁波路9号上海商业储蓄银行副经理 T. C. Tsiang（音译：蒋廷黻）先生。他表示，银行在与卢森堡的 C. J. Kerr 先生有关的伪造提单案中遭受了资金损失，但无法说明具体金额，因为所有文件和单据已 forwarded 至伦敦伦巴第街32号的“Guranty Trust Co”（原文如此，应为 Guaranty Trust Co.）。Tsiang 先生随后出示了他收到的两封信件的副本，一封来自“Guranty Trust Co”，另一封来自他在汉堡的一位朋友。（随函附上）Tsiang 先生还表示，他听说汉口路13号的浙江实业银行和外滩12号的汇丰银行也在伪造提单案中遭受了损失。

1930年4月25日下午2时30分许，签署人在汉口路13号浙江实业银行约谈了该银行外事部副经理 Z. H. Kung（音译：孔祥熙）先生，他出示了一张1927年10月13日开给卢森堡的 C. J. Kerr 先生、账户为外滩6号“Wha Chang Shun Co”（音译：华昌顺公司）的712英镑10先令贷记通知单。（随函附上贷记通知单副本）浙江实业银行未遭受任何损失。

根据 T.C. Tsiang 先生提供的信息，签署人于1930年4月25日下午3时15分许约谈了外滩12号汇丰银行的会计师 Beatty 先生，他出示了一张1928年2月14日开给卢森堡的 C. J. Kerr 先生、账户为海宁路 P.D. 2768a 号“Yue Tah Co”（音译：悦达公司）的500英镑银行汇票。（随函附上汇票指令副本）

1930年4月26日上午8时45分许，在海宁路 P.D. 2768a 号的“Yue Tah Co”进行了查询，获悉经理 Wong 先生只能在江西路33号的“Cosmos Paper Co”（音译：宇宙纸行）接受约谈，因为他是那里的买办。1930年4月26日上午11时许，签署人在“Cosmos Paper Co”约谈了 Wong 先生，他表示，由于与“Yue Tah Co”和 C.J. Kerr 先生有关的订单及时取消，避免了任何损失，因此他只损失了少量的电报费，且他们电汇给 C.J. Kerr 先生的500英镑银行汇票已被取消。
随函附上一封来自“Yue Tah Co”的信，说明了他们与 Kerr 先生的业务往来情况。

1930年4月26日上午10时20分许，约谈了外滩6号“Wha Chang Shun Co”经理 Chau Jen Zar（音译：周仁斋）先生，他表示，1927年和1928年与 C.J. Kerr 先生有关的损失约为1770英镑。Chau 先生随后出示了与 Kerr 先生业务往来的订单和信函，这些业务始于1927年 C.J. Kerr 先生发送给东瑟瓦德路2656/7号“Tah Tai Shing”（音译：泰泰兴）的一份通告信函，因“Tah Tai Shing”不经营纸张业务，该信函被转交给 Chau Jen Zar 先生。（随函附上“Wha Chang Shun Co”与 Kerr 先生之间的订单和信函副本。

Copy of a letter sent to the Shanghai Commercial Bank from the

London 7th March, 1930.

We refer to previous correspondence exchanged early
in 1928 regarding the money drawn by C. J. Kerr of Luxemburg
against forged Bills of Lading tendered under your authorities
to purchase, and have to advise that we now learn from the police
authorities here that Kerr has been arrested in Belgium upon the
application of the Swiss Police.

In anticipation of his trial in Switzerland we have
made a full statement to the police and handed to them all the
necessary papers and documents to support our statement.

We understand that another London Bank has suffered
losses amounting to more than £6,000.-

The authorities are hopeful that when the trial is
concluded Kerr will receive a sentence of approximately 10 years'
imprisonment, which should dispose of any possibility of his ever
again becoming a menace to trade. We are afraid this is the only
consolation we can expect as any recovery of the money is now out
of the question.

鉴于他即将在瑞士受审，我方已向警方作出全面陈述，并将支持我方陈述的所有必要文件和单据移交给他们。

据悉，另一家伦敦银行遭受的损失超过 6,000 英镑。

当局希望，审判结束后，Kerr 将被判处约 10 年监禁，这将消除他再次成为贸易威胁的任何可能性。恐怕这是我们唯一能期待的慰藉，因为追回款项现已无望。

Hamburg April 3rd, 1930.

Notice in newspaper in Hamburg on April 3rd 1930
in regard to Kerrcase

" " Since three years the police
of several countries have been hunting after a big-
scale swindler who is reported to have victimized
many firms in Switzerland, Belgium and in Hamburg.
The hunt became rather difficult on account of the
culprit changing his name so often. But now he is
put under arrest in Tournai in Belgium. He has confess-
ed a part of his swindles. His name is Christo Caryfalis
a Greek subject. In Hamburg he perpetrated his manoeuvres
under the name of Sir John Kerr posing as representative
of large British Paper Factories for which he booked orders.
Sometime after having done so he presented bills of lading
insurance policies etc. against which he collected the
amount of the invoices and when the buyers presented the
papers for delivery they found that all was forged. It is
reported that Sir John was successful in Hamburg alone in
127 cases yielding £50.000.- "

汉堡，1930 年 4 月 3 日。

1930 年 4 月 3 日汉堡报纸上关于 Kerr 案的报道

“三年来，多国警方一直在追捕一名大规模诈骗犯，据报道，他在瑞士、比利时和汉堡使许多公司受害。由于罪犯频繁改名，追捕工作相当困难。但现在他已在比利时图尔奈（Tournai）被捕。他已承认部分诈骗行为。他的名字是 Christo Caryfalis，希腊籍公民。在汉堡，他化名 Sir John Kerr，冒充大型英国造纸厂的代表接受订单。此后不久，他出示提单、保险单等文件，据此收取发票金额，而当买家持单据提货时，发现所有文件均为伪造。据报道，仅在汉堡一地，Sir John 就成功作案 127 起，涉案金额达 50,000 英镑。”

Dear Sirs, re. C. J. Kerr of Luxemburg.

We are sorry to say that we cannot find the
copies of orders and correspondences between us and J. J. Kerr
as this matter we have considered nil and void because we have
only lost some small expenses in cable fee.

For your information we beg to say that we have
received a letter during the month of September 1927 from
J. J. Kerr at Luxemburg offering us a few kinds of papers
such as Newspaper and Kraft Papers etc., etc., in which
he said that he has been acting as representative of 2 newly
established paper mills therefore he could give us a very
reasonable price for the samples enclosed.

has been accepted by him by cable upon receipt of our letter
for the shipments January and February 1928 and we have also
placed an order for 20 tons Klassike Paper for February 1928
shipments altogether about £ 1300/0/0 for 3 orders which
he asked us to open confirmed Bankers Letter of Credit by
wire for him to draw at 90 days sight draft at London.

我们对他的回复感到可疑，因为他未向我们提供其银行资信参考以供查证。随后，我们致函所有本地外资银行，如中比国际银行和香港上海汇丰银行。我们从上述银行得到回复，称不认识此人，但将为我们进行调查，并致函其伦敦办事处，适时通知我们。

但是，上海商业储蓄银行告诉我的朋友，他们已为当地中国进口商开立了数千英镑的信用证，但也通过其伦敦代理机构进行了调查，结果显示 J. J. Kerr 是一位正当商人，但并不富有，他经常因业务前往外地港口，并租用了一间小办公室。

鉴于上海商业储蓄银行已为其他中国进口商开立了信用证，我们敢于为 J. J. Kerr 开立小额信用证。因此，我们于 1928 年 2 月 27 日电请香港上海汇丰银行开具一份以 J. J. Kerr 为受益人、金额为 500 英镑的“保函”，这仅覆盖我们订单的三分之一。我们同时电告 J. J. Kerr，银行目前开立的信用证不超过 500 英镑，余款将在第一批货物到达后跟进。1928 年 3 月 11 日，我们通过朋友从上海商业银行得知消息，称他们收到了提单，但在指定轮船上并无货物。因此他们电询伦敦代理机构，回复如下：K

20th February, 28.

C. J. Kerr, Esq.,
Poste Gare Case51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sir,

We are sending you herewith our order form No. 0060 for
50 tons Newsprint Paper, April shipment and also copies of
telegrams passed between ourselves for this lot of business. We
hope that the same will be found in order and shipment be effected
in due time.

Letter of credit for our order No. 56. We are having some
trouble in opening the credit to you. The reason being that we
transact most of our business through the Shanghai Commercial &
Savings Bank, here and their London agents Are The Guaranty Trust
Company of New York. The said banks do not understand you very well
as you have not give us your banker for reference. Their report is
that you are not always at Luxembourg and only keep an office there.
Thus The Shanghai bank refused to open credit in your favour and we
have to change our bank in order to fulfill our promise and as the
shipment for the kraft paper is to be March we opened the credit
by cable. To our idea as you are agent for the mills, there is no
reason why you should keep an enormous office and the bank must
have misunderstood you. But for the convenience of us, we shall
be glad if you will kindly give us your banker as reference either
at Luxembourg or one of bank at Metz so as to enable us to satisfy
our banks and results to much facility for the future business.

Shipping Documents. We beg to ask you to give us one of
your sales Note for each lot of business confirmed so as to fill
our file. On the invoice and bill of landing please put always
clearly the mark and number of packages so as to save trouble of
examing the cargo by the customs here. After shipping please
send us one non-negotiable copy of shipping documents and also
ten to twenty sheets of the paper shipped as shipping sample
directly to our address so as to enable us much easier in taking
delivery of the cargo.

Trusting this will meet your usual prompt attention and
favour us with your early reply to the same.

Yours Faithfully,

1928年2月20日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
Poste Gare Case51，
卢森堡。

尊敬的先生：

兹随函附上我方第0060号订单，订购新闻纸50吨，要求四月装运；并附上就这批业务往来所发电报的副本。希望一切符合要求，并能按时装运。

关于我方第56号订单的信用证。我们在向贵方开立信用证时遇到了一些困难。原因是我们在此地的大部分业务均通过上海商业储蓄银行办理，而该行的伦敦代理行是纽约担保信托公司（The Guaranty Trust Company of New York）。由于贵方未向我方提供往来银行以供资信参考，上述银行对贵方了解甚少。据其报告称，贵方并非常驻卢森堡，仅在那里设有一处办事处。因此，上海商业储蓄银行拒绝以贵方为受益人开立信用证，而我方为履行承诺，不得不更换银行；鉴于牛皮纸的装运期定为三月，我们已通过电报开立了信用证。在我方看来，既然贵方是各造纸厂的代理商，便没有理由维持庞大的办公机构，银行方面一定是误解了贵方的情况。但为了我方便利起见，如蒙惠示贵方在卢森堡的往来银行，或梅斯（Metz）任一银行的名称作为资信参考，以便我方向我方银行作出交代，并将为今后的业务带来极大便利，我方将不胜感激。

运输单据。恳请贵方在每批业务确认后，提供一份销售确认书（Sales Note），以便我方归档。请在发票和提单上始终清晰注明包装的唛头及编号，以免此处海关查验货物时产生麻烦。装运后，请直接向我们的地址寄送一套不可议付的运输单据副本，以及十至二十张所装运纸张的样品，作为装运样本，以便我方更顺利地提取货物。

相信此事能得到贵方惯常的及时关注，并盼早日复函。

此致
敬礼

OMCVT 优质
SECHAILER

page_data.en:
0004

2nd November, 27.

C. J. Kerr Esq.,
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sir,

We are in receipt of your favour of the 11th ult. and the contents
of which has been all carefully noted.

Unglazed Newsprint, 50 tons. We appreciate that the price quoted
by you and that of £14-5-0 to which our first lot of business was closed.
is in line with our market and a little bit cheaper than what others
have quoted. We have at present business on hand for the same kind of
paper, but on account of we have not had the pleasure of receiving
actual shipment before, we are compelled to wait until the first lot
arrived here. We can only be conservative as we have had troubles before
in the weight per ream and quality.

Unglazed Kraft. We have also business on hand for this kind of
paper, but on reviewing your sample we found that that of 39gr. is
seemingly thicker than that of 44 gr. Thus we afraid there might be a
mistake. Therefore we suggest that after this letter reached you, to
ship us one or two bales each of
Unglazed Kraft, 36 x 48, 47 lbs. 500 sheets 12 reams per bale
Do do 56 lbs. do 9 do
to us as sample and draw on us at sight for the cost. After the receiving
of these sample bales, we can know exactly your way of packing and
quality and without doubt we will be in the position to offer you
much business. Should this be too small for making a sample shipment
please cable us the amount you will ship.

Trusting this will meet your valuable attention and favour us
your reply in due course.

Yours Faithfully,
page_data.zh:
0004

1927年11月2日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
卢森堡，火车站信箱 51号，

尊敬的先生：

我方已收到您上月11日的惠函，并仔细知悉了函中内容。

关于未上光新闻纸，50吨。我方感谢您所报价格，该价格与我方首批交易达成的14英镑5先令的价格相符，符合我方市场行情，且略低于其他商家的报价。我方目前手头也有同类纸张的业务，但由于此前未曾有幸收到实际装运的货物，我方不得不等待第一批货物抵达此处。鉴于我方过去在每令重量和质量方面曾遇到过麻烦，因此只能持谨慎态度。

关于未上光牛皮纸。我方手头也有此类纸张的业务，但在审阅贵方样品后，我方发现39克的样品似乎比44克的还要厚。因此，我方担心其中可能有误。故建议在此信送达后，请向我方装运以下样品各一两包：
未上光牛皮纸，36 x 48英寸，47磅，500张，每包12令
同上，56磅，同上，每包9令
作为样品寄给我方，并就费用向我方开具即期汇票。收到这些样品包后，我方即可确切了解贵方的包装方式及质量，毫无疑问，届时我方将能够向贵方提供大量业务。若此数量对于样品装运而言太少，请电告我方您将装运的数量。

相信此事能得到您的重视，并期盼您及时回复。

您忠实的，

page_data.en:
14th October, 27.

C. J. Kerr Esq.,
Post Office Box No. 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sir,

We beg to acknowledge the receipt of your telegram of
the 11th inst., as per translation enclosed, accepting our
offer of 50 tons Newsprint Paper, for which we are sending you
herewith our indent.

We regret that we have expressed ourselves a little too
forcibly in our letter of the 11th, as we were not feeling
satisfied at receiving no reply to our cable offer for the first
lot of business.

This 50 tons we ordered is only a trial order, if the
same proves satisfactory, we are sure that much business will be
effected in the future. We beg to point one thing which is of
the most importance to the newsprint paper, that is the weight
per ream must be 37 lbs. or over and not under. As we have already
got trouble before on this point, we hope that this will be to
your valuable attention.

We propose that if possible we wish to have a trade mark
be put on the cover of every ream of paper exclusively for our
orders only. We are sending you by next mail a copy of the
design of trade mark we wish to have and hope it will be in time
for the first lot yet.

Trusting we will hear from you in due course,

Yours Faithfully,

P. S. We have established a credit in your favour for the above
order at the National Provincial Bank, London. The usance is 90 day
D/P with interest of 7% on the draft.
page_data.zh:
1927年10月14日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
卢森堡，邮政信箱 51号，

尊敬的先生：

兹确认收到您本月11日的电报，译文附后，该电报接受了我方关于50吨新闻纸的报价，为此我方随函附上订货单。

遗憾我方在11日的信中措辞稍显强硬，这是因为对我方就首批业务发出的电报报价未获回复感到不满。

此次订购的50吨仅为试订单，若结果令人满意，相信未来将达成大量交易。谨提请贵方注意一点，这对新闻纸至关重要，即每令重量必须为37磅或以上，不得低于此数。鉴于我方此前在此问题上曾遇到麻烦，望贵方予以重视。

我方提议，若有可能，希望在专为我方订单生产的每令纸张外包装上印制商标。我方将在下一班邮件中寄去希望使用的商标设计图样，希望能赶得上用于第一批货物。

相信不久能收到您的回音，

您忠实的，

附言：我方已在伦敦国民省立银行 (National Provincial Bank, London) 为上述订单以贵方名义开立信用证。期限为见票后90天付款交单 (D/P)，汇票利息为7%。

page_data.en:
0002
11th October, 27.

C. J. Kerr Esq.,
Post Box No. 51,
Launceston.

Dear Sir,

We beg to acknowledge the receipt of your favour of the 14th ult. and thank you for the quotations given to us. Your samples of paper were also duly received.

We are surprised that we did not received any reply to our cable offer to you for buying 50 tons Newsprint. In this cable we mentioned your letter of the 14th ult. and also in order to be simple we give you the nett price instead of that with discount. Also we mentioned in our cable the question about the period of draft which is to mean that you can draw on us upon our credit with interest for our account on the draft. This was expressed in our cable as we learned from your letter that your bank will charge you interest for drafts other than sight draft. In our arrangement you can get cash at your side and leave the interest be paid by us.

As we did not receive your cable reply to our 5th cable we again sent you a cable on the 8th and signed our cable for fearing that you might in trouble of knowing from whom the cable of 5th was sent. But up to present we still have not heard anything from you we beg to take the liberty of asking you whether you have received our cable or not.

Enclosed please find the copies of telegrams we sent. As we are quite willing to do business with your goodself, as soon as we received your letter, we made you a trial offer, but we are surely not so satisfied at receiving no reply. Hoping our further inquiries may be more successful than the present one.

Yours very truly,
page_data.zh:
0002
1927年10月11日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
朗塞斯顿 (Launceston)，51号信箱。

尊敬的先生：

兹确认收到您上月14日的惠函，并感谢贵方提供的报价。贵方的纸张样品也已 duly 收到。

令我方惊讶的是，我方未收到贵方对我方购买50吨新闻纸的电报报价的任何回复。在该电报中，我方提及了您上月14日的来信，并且为了简便起见，我方给出的是净价而非折扣价。此外，我方在电报中还提到了汇票期限的问题，意指贵方可凭我方信用证开具汇票，利息由我方承担。我方在电报中如此表述，是因为从贵方来信中得知，贵方银行会对非即期汇票收取利息。按我方安排，贵方可在当地获得现金，而利息由我方支付。

由于未收到贵方对我方5日电报的回复，我方于8日再次向贵方发电报，并在电报中署名，以免贵方难以知晓5日电报的发件人。但截至目前，我方仍未收到任何消息，故冒昧询问贵方是否已收到我方电报。

随函附上我方所发电报的副本。我方非常愿意与贵方做生意，因此在收到贵方来信后立即发出了试盘报价，但对于未获回复实在感到不甚满意。希望我方进一步的询价能比此次更为成功。

您非常真诚的，

page_data.en:
0001

23rd August, 27.

C. J. Kerr Esq.,
Poste Gare Case 51,
[Illegible]

Dear Sir,

Your letter of the 30th July was handed to us by Messrs. Tah
Tai Shing of this town as they do not import paper directly. Carefully
noting the contents of your letter and the samples, we are quite will-
ing to enter into business with yourself, this leads us to take
the liberty of writing you.

We, with our connections in Northern and Central China have
regular demands for every kinds of paper and can consume a considerable
amount yearly.

From your sample, we are interested in Unglazed Newsprint in
sheets and unglazed Kraft Paper. As we are not acquainted in your
weight of grams, we beg to mention here what we are interested:
Unglazed Newsprint, 31 x 43", 37 lbs per ream of 500 sheets.
Packed 15 reams in a bale, reams separated with paper
band.
Unglazed Kraft Paper, 36 x 48½ weight per ream of 480 sheets.
Weights:- 48, 57, 65, 72, 82, 92, lbs per ream.
Packed about 500 lbs per bale.

Besides the above mentioned we are also interested in M.G. Cap
Paper, white and colored, Book Paper, Wood free Printing Paper, Flint
Paper, Glassine Paper, wall Paper and Blotting Paper etc. Should your
factory be also good for these paper, please send us samples for the
same.

Terms. We agree with your term of price per ton of 2240 lbs.
with 2% discount and still more with your limit of the least amount
to be ordered at one time. But regarding to the credit, our business
with all of our European Correspondents in Glass, Hardware, Paper and
sundries are on the basis of Revocable Credit with recourse, and open-
ed by mail if for shipment of some months ahead and by cable if for
immediate shipment. The usance is either 90 days or 120 days D/P.
Trusting you will no trouble in accepting our term as it is the usual
form of credit now employed in the paper business.

Shipment. The shipping time must be contracted for a certain
month and it must be strictly adhered to. In a case a delay is un-
avoidable, it must be notified to us by cable.
page_data.zh:
0001

1927年8月23日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
火车站信箱 51号，
[原文不清]

尊敬的先生：

本市达泰盛 (Tah Tai Shing) 商行将您7月30日的来信转交予我方，因为他们不直接进口纸张。在仔细知悉您来信内容及样品后，我方非常愿意与贵方建立业务关系，故此冒昧致函。

我方凭借在华北和华中的联系网络，对各类纸张有定期需求，年消耗量相当可观。

从贵方样品来看，我方对平张未上光新闻纸和未上光牛皮纸感兴趣。由于我方不熟悉贵方的克重标准，特此说明我方感兴趣的具体规格：
未上光新闻纸，31 x 43英寸，每令500张重37磅。
包装：每包15令，令与令之间用纸带隔开。
未上光牛皮纸，36 x 48½英寸，每令480张的重量。
重量：每令48、57、65、72、82、92磅。
包装：每包约500磅。

除上述品种外，我方还对机制帽纸（白色及彩色）、书纸、无木浆印刷纸、弗林特纸 (Flint Paper)、玻璃纸、墙纸及吸墨纸等感兴趣。若贵厂也擅长生产这些纸张，请寄送相应样品。

条款。我方同意贵方按每长吨 (2240磅) 计价并给予2%折扣的价格条款，也同意贵方关于单次最低订货量的限制。但在信用证方面，我方与所有欧洲玻璃、五金、纸张及杂货通信行的业务均基于有追索权的可撤销信用证，若为数月后的装运则通过信函开立，若为立即装运则通过电报开立。期限为见票后90天或120天付款交单 (D/P)。相信贵方接受我方条款应无困难，因为这是目前纸张业务中常用的信用证形式。

装运。装运时间必须约定在特定月份，并须严格遵守。若发生不可避免的延误，必须通过电报通知我方。

page_data.en:
2

C. J. Kerr Esq.,
Luxembourg.
Reference No. 0001-

References. Our bankers are Banque Belge pour l'Etranger
and the Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank (National Provincial Bank,
London, their agents) of Shanghai. And you can get our reference as
to the responsibility and ability from them or the Banque Belge pour
l'Etranger in Brussels. In return we beg to ask your reference.

Cable Code. We use Acme Code and Bentley's Code. But as most
of our business will be done by telegrams, and no code will be eco-
nomical enough to the paper business except private one, we shall be
glad if you can send us your private code if you had that prepared.
We have both to sign the cable untill we have started our business
and a special Cable Adress be registered for our exclusive use.

Hoping the above will be to your valuable consideration
and favour us with your reply at an early date.

Yours very truly,
page_data.zh:
2

C. J. Kerr 先生，
卢森堡。
参考编号 0001-

参考资料。我们的往来银行是比利时海外银行（Banque Belge pour l'Etranger）
和上海商业储蓄银行（其代理行为伦敦的国民地方银行，
National Provincial Bank, London）。您可以从他们那里，或从布鲁塞尔的比利时海外银行
获取关于我们信誉和能力的资信证明。作为交换，我们也恳请贵方提供资信证明。

电报密码。我们使用 Acme 密码和 Bentley 密码。但由于我们的大部分业务
将通过电报进行，且除了私人密码外，没有哪种密码对纸张业务来说足够经济，
因此，如果贵方已备有私人密码，若能发送给我们，我们将不胜感激。
在我们开始业务并为专用目的注册特别电报地址之前，
电报需由我们双方签署。

希望上述事项能得到贵方的重视，
并盼早日赐复。

您忠实的，

page_data.en:
0005

21st November, 27.

C. J. Kerr Esq.,
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sir,

We beg to confirm the telegrams passed between ourselves
as per copies enclosed, which results that we have bought from you
75 tons White Newsprint paper. For which we are sending you our
order form.

Our dealer wish to have have this 75 tons be shipped in
two lots, therefore we shall be glad if you can do so should it cost
you no expense extra. We are making the credit to be in force a little
longer so as to enable you to have enough time.

In comparison of your sample with these of others, yours
is little bit thinner and darker in colour. As some of this kind of
paper is used here for wrapping, so thicker the better. If you can
improve your quality or may be your actual shipment is better than the
sample we are sure they will be more popular here and results to more
business in future.

Trusting to hear from you in due course, we remain,

Yours Faithfully,
page_data.zh:
0005

1927年11月21日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
邮局留局待取 51号信箱，
卢森堡。

尊敬的先生：

兹确认我们之间往来的电报，副本附后，据此我们已向贵方购买
75吨白色新闻纸。为此，现随函附上我们的订单。

我们的经销商希望将这75吨货物分两批装运，因此，如果此举不增加
额外费用，若蒙照办，我们将不胜感激。我们将信用证的有效期稍作延长，
以便贵方有充足的时间。

将贵方样品与其他家的样品相比，贵方的样品略薄且颜色较深。由于此处
部分此类纸张用于包装，因此越厚越好。如果贵方能改进质量，或者实际
装运的货物优于样品，我们相信它们在这里会更受欢迎，从而在未来带来
更多的业务。

期待适时收到贵方来信，

您忠实的，

23rd December, 27.

C. J. Kerr Esq..
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sirs,

We beg to acknowledge the receipt of your letter of the
26th ult. and the contents been to our carefully attention.

We are now sending you enclosed a sample of Gray Wrapping
Paper which we have constant demand. As you will see from our sample
that this paper is only of low grade material and one side uglazed.
The paper is to be " 24 x 36"-- 70 lbs. per ream of 500 sheets and
packed in bales of 20 reams each. Trusting you can approach the
mill for the same and send us your quotation and counter sample for
this paper. It is to be said that for this kind of paper the color
is very important. If the first lot is supplied with one certain
degree of color the next lots must be of the same kind. We have
big and regular demands for this paper. The paper is used here for
wrapping cotton yarn, therefore the demand is large but the spinning
mills usually do not like to change the color of their wrapping
paper.

Kraft Paper. We duly received your new sample and found
the same being all right. As now is the time of Christmas and holidays
we trust that we will be able to give you a trial order of 10/20 tons
right after the New Year.

With nothing further for this mail, we remain,

Yours Faithfully,
page_data.zh:
0008

1927年12月23日。

C. J. Kerr 先生..
邮局留局待取 51号信箱，
卢森堡。

尊敬的先生们：

兹确认收到贵方上月26日来信，内容已悉心阅悉。

现随函附上灰色包装纸样品一份，此乃我方常年需求之货。从样品中
可见，该纸仅为低档材料，且单面未上光。纸张规格应为“24 x 36英寸”——
每令500张重70磅，每20令打包成一捆。相信贵方能向工厂询价，
并就此种纸张向我方提供报价及回样。需指出的是，对此类纸张而言，
颜色至关重要。如果第一批供货具有某种特定的色泽，后续批次必须
保持相同。我方对此种纸张有大量且稳定的需求。该纸在此处用于
包裹棉纱，因此需求量很大，但纺纱厂通常不愿改变其包装纸的颜色。

牛皮纸。我方已 duly 收到贵方新样品，发现一切正常。鉴于目前正值
圣诞节及假期期间，相信新年过后不久，我方便能向贵方下达10至20吨
的试订单。

此次去信无其他事宜，

您忠实的，

page_data.en:
0007
2nd December, 27.

C. J. Kerr, Esq.,
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sir,

We are in receipt of your favour of the 4th ult. and
all the contents been carefully noted.

It is much to our pleasure that you are willing to
print a special label for us and be pasted on every ream of paper.
Herewith we beg to send you our rough design of the label we intend
to have and hoping the same will still in time for the first
trial shipment yet.

The label we send you is what we called in Chinese
" Precious Ingots". As we have not colored the design, we hope
that you do the best to give it some simple colors, only the three
bigger ingots and the small one in the child's hand must be colored
either gold, yellow or yellowish brown as they represent
gold ingots. The apron of the child must be colored red. As to
the characters and flag etc. we have no choice of anykind, you can
colored them with any color, simpler the better, as to facilitate
time and expence.

Trusting this will meet your valuable attention, With
nothing further for this mail, we beg to wish you a happy Christmas
and a prosperous New Year.

Yours Faithfully,
page_data.zh:
0007
1927年12月2日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
邮局留局待取 51号信箱，
卢森堡。

尊敬的先生：

兹收到贵方上月4日来函，所有内容均已仔细 noted。

贵方愿意为我方印制特殊标签并粘贴在每令纸上，这令我们十分高兴。
现随函附上我方拟使用的标签草图，希望赶得上第一批
试运货物。

我方寄给贵方的标签，中文称为“元宝”。由于设计稿未上色，希望
贵方尽力为其配上简单的颜色，其中三个较大的元宝以及孩童手中
的小元宝必须涂成金色、黄色或黄褐色，因为它们代表
金元宝。孩童的围裙必须涂成红色。至于文字和旗帜等，我方
无任何偏好，贵方可用任何颜色涂抹，越简单越好，以节省
时间和费用。

相信此事能得到贵方的重视，此次去信无其他事宜，谨祝
圣诞快乐，新年兴旺。

您忠实的，

page_data.en:
0006
26th November, 27.

C. J. Kerr, Esq.
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sirs

We beg to acknowledge the receipt of your telegram of the
25th inst. confirming the 75 tons White Newsprint Paper sold by you.
We beg to advise you that all is in order and we have forwarded the

7th. May 28.

C. J. Kerr, Esq.,
60, Bd. de la Petrusse,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sir,

With reference to our various letters in connection
with the shipments of paper as per our various contracts, we
regret that we have not heard from you and that we have not
received any explanation of your very unsatisfactory conduct
and fulfilment of your contracts with us.

We have so far behaved towards yourself in a most
gentlemen and business way and we are consequently very astonished
as to your conduct towards discharging your liabilities insofar
as your contracts are concerned.

The loss we have suffered is considerable, what with
meeting your drafts, out-of-pocket expenses, indemnities to the
dealer, etc., and we must look to you for the re-imbursement
thereof.

And we are giving you notice that should you not
reply to our letters and to the various demands raised therein,
we will be compelled to request your authorities to protect our
interests. We do so regretfully but you must realize that you
are dealing with gentlemen and that as such, you will always be
treated like one. But should you not consider yourself as one,
we will take measures to protect ourselves and other credulous
merchants and place you where crooks and swindlers should be.

Yours faithfully,
page_data.zh:
7th. 5月28日。

C. J. Kerr 先生，
佩特鲁斯大道60号，
卢森堡。

尊敬的先生：

关于我们根据各项合同装运纸张事宜的往来信函，遗憾至今未获你方回音，亦未收到你方就履行与我方合同过程中极不令人满意的行为所作任何解释。

迄今为止，我方对待阁下一直秉持最为绅士及商业化的方式，因此，对于阁下在履行合同责任方面的表现，我们深感震惊。

我方遭受的损失相当巨大，包括兑付你方汇票、垫付费用、向经销商支付的赔偿金等，我们必须要求你方予以偿还。

特此通知，若你方不回复我方信函及其中提出的各项要求，我们将被迫请求有关当局保护我方利益。此举实属无奈，但你方必须意识到，你方是在与绅士打交道，因此也将始终受到绅士般的待遇。但若你方不自视为绅士，我们将采取措施保护自身及其他轻信商人的利益，并将你方置于骗子和欺诈者应处的地位。

此致，

11th April, 28.

C. J. Kerr, Esq.,
Poste Gare Case 51,
LUXEMBOURG.

Sir,

We beg to send you the copies of telegrams passed between
ourselves. We are very much surprised of learning that the B/L
for the shipments on Carl Legien were all forged. We cable you
on the 18th & 28th March regarding this matter and asked you of
what could you do. To this we have not as yet favoured with any
reply.

We are extremely distressed of this matter being and need
not to say we will hold you responsible for all the loss thus
caused. Anyhow we are eager to know what is the real thing happed
at your side and from whom was this forgery done, and also what is
your present way to settle the matter.

Trusting we will be favoured with your early reply to a
definite way of settling the matter.

Yours Truly,

卢森堡。

先生：

此事令我们极为苦恼，毋庸赘言，我们将要求你方对由此造成的一切损失负责。无论如何，我们迫切希望了解你方实际发生的情况、伪造行为系何人所为，以及你方目前解决此事的方案。

相信你会早日回复，提出解决此事的确切办法。

此致，

INSTITUTE CARGO CLAUSES (W.A.)
1 1. Warranted free of capture, seizure, arrest, restraint or detainment, and the conse-
2 quences thereof or of any attempt thereat (piracy excepted), and also from all conse-
3 quences of hostilities or warlike operations, whether before or after declaration of war.
4 2. Warranted free of loss or damage caused by strikers, locked-out workmen, or persons
5 taking part in labour disturbances, or riots or civil commotions.
6 Should Clause No. 1 be deleted, Clause No. 3 is to operate as part of this Policy.
7 3. Warranted free of any claim based upon loss of, or frustration of, the insured voyage, or
8 adventure, caused by arrests, restraints or detainments of kings, princes or peoples.
9 4. General Average and Salvage Charges payable according to Foreign Statement or per
10 York-Antwerp Rules if in accordance with the contract of affreightment.
11 5. Held covered at a premium to be arranged in case of deviation or change of voyage, or
12 other variation of the risk by reason of the exercise of any liberty granted to the ship-
13 owner or charterer under the contract of affreightment, or of any omission or error in
14 the description of the interest vessel or voyage.
15 6. The risks covered by this Policy attach from the time the goods leave the shipper’s
16 or manufacturer’s warehouse at the port of shipment, unless otherwise stated, and
17 continue during the ordinary course of transit, including customary transhipment if
18 any, until the goods are safely deposited in the consignee’s or other warehouse at the
19 destination named in the Policy or until the expiry of fifteen days from midnight of
20 the day on which the discharge of the goods hereby insured from the overseas
21 vessel is completed whichever may first occur. When the destination to which
22 the goods are insured is without the limits of the port of discharge of the overseas
23 vessel the risks covered by this Policy continue until the goods are safely deposited
24 in the consignee’s or other warehouse at the destination named in the Policy or until
25 the expiry of 30 days from midnight of the day on which the discharge of the goods
26 hereby insured from the overseas vessel is completed, whichever may first occur.
27 Transhipment if any, otherwise than as above, and/or delay arising from circum-
28 stances beyond the control of the assured, held covered at a premium to be arranged.
29 7. Including transit by craft, raft and/or lighter to and from the vessel. Each craft, raft,
30 and/or lighter to be deemed a separate insurance. The assured are not to be pre-
31 judiced by any agreement exempting lightermen from liability.
32 8. The Assured at ; not to be prejudiced by the presence of the negligence clause and/or
33 latent defect clause in the Bills of Lading and/or Charter Party. The seaworthiness
34 of the vessel as between the Assured and the Assurers is hereby admitted and the
35 wrongful act or misconduct of the shipowner or his servants causing a loss is not to
36 defeat the recovery by an innocent Assured if the loss in the absence of such wrong-
37 ful act or misconduct would have been a loss recoverable on the Policy. With leave
38 to sail with or without pilots, and to tow and assist vessels or craft in all situations,
39 and to be towed.
40 9. Warranted free from average under the percentage specified in the Policy, unless
41 general, or the vessel or craft be stranded, sunk or burnt, but notwithstanding this
42 warranty the Assurers are to pay the insured value of any package which may be
43 totally lost in loading, transhipment or discharge, also for any loss of or damage to

45 of the vessel and/or craft and/or conveyance with any external substance (ice included)
46 other than water, or to discharge of cargo at port of distress. This warranty shall

“保证不保因捕获、扣押、逮捕、限制或拘留及其后果，或任何此类企图之后果（海盗行为除外），以及不论在宣战之前或之后，因敌对行为或战争行动产生的一切后果。”
“保证不保因罢工者、被锁厂工人或参与劳资纠纷、暴动或民变之人所造成的损失或损害。”
但排除因战争、敌对行为等导致延误而引起的变质、共同海损、市场损失或其他损失的任何索赔。
包括水雷、鱼雷、炸弹等。
允许绕航。
不因保险利益不足或注销而退费。
保证不保因国王、王子或人民的逮捕、限制或拘留导致受保航程或冒险丧失或受挫而产生的任何索赔。

1937 年 1 月 1 日
协会货物条款（水渍险）
1 1. 保证不保因捕获、扣押、逮捕、限制或拘留及其后果，或任何此类企图之后果（海盗行为除外），以及不论在宣战之前或之后，因敌对行为或战争行动产生的一切后果。
2 2. 保证不保因罢工者、被锁厂工人或参与劳资纠纷、暴动或民变之人所造成的损失或损害。
3 若删除第 1 条，则第 3 条将作为本保险单的一部分生效。
4 3. 保证不保因国王、王子或人民的逮捕、限制或拘留导致受保航程或冒险丧失或受挫而产生的任何索赔。
5 4. 共同海损和救助费用按照国外理算书支付，若符合运输合同规定，则按照《约克-安特卫普规则》支付。
6 5. 若因行使运输合同授予船东或承租人的任何权利而导致绕航或改变航程，或因保险标的、船舶或航程描述中的任何遗漏或错误而导致风险发生其他变化，则在需另行安排保费的情况下予以承保。
7 6. 除非另有规定，本保险单承保的风险自货物离开装运港发货人或制造商仓库时开始，并在通常运输过程中持续有效，包括惯常转运（如有），直至货物安全存入保险单指定目的地的收货人或其他仓库，或直至本保险单项下货物从远洋船舶卸毕之日午夜起满十五天，以先发生者为准。当货物投保的目的地超出远洋船舶卸货港范围时，本保险单承保的风险持续至货物安全存入保险单指定目的地的收货人或其他仓库，或直至本保险单项下货物从远洋船舶卸毕之日午夜起满三十天，以先发生者为准。
8 除上述情况外的转运（如有），和/或因被保险人无法控制的情况引起的延误，在需另行安排保费的情况下予以承保。
9 7. 包括通过驳船、木筏和/或轻舟往返船舶的运输。每艘驳船、木筏和/或轻舟应视为单独的保险。任何免除轻舟船夫责任的协议不得损害被保险人的利益。
10 8. 被保险人位于；提单和/或租船合约中存在疏忽条款和/或潜在缺陷条款，不得损害被保险人的利益。在此承认被保险人与保险人之间船舶的适航性，且若船东或其仆人的不法行为或不当行为造成损失，而在没有此类不法行为或不当行为的情况下该损失本可根据保险单获得赔偿，则无辜被保险人获得赔偿的权利不应因此类不法行为或不当行为而失效。允许有引航员或无引航员航行，并在各种情况下拖带和协助船舶或驳船，以及被拖带。
11 9. 保证不保低于保险单规定百分比的部分损失，除非是共同海损，或船舶或驳船搁浅、沉没或烧毁，但尽管有此保证，保险人仍应支付在装载、转运或卸货过程中完全灭失的任何包装件的保险价值，以及可合理归因于火灾、碰撞，或船舶和/或驳船和/或运输工具与任何外部物质（包括冰）而非水的接触，或在避难港卸货造成的受保标的的任何损失或损害。此保证应在保险单涵盖的整个期间内有效。

WAH CHANG LETTER TO C.J. KERR

Letter No.2320
Shanghai, November 1, 1927.

Messrs. C.J. Kerr,
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sirs,
Re: Our Import Order No.212 - 100 tons
Unglazed Newsprint No. 123

After several exchanges of cables between us, we are happy
to be able to book this initial order of 100 tons Unglazed Newsprint
from you, and herewith are sending you our formal order sheet No.212
covering the purchase at £ 14.10.0. per ton of 2240 lbs. c.i.f.
Shanghai less 2% as our commission.

We attach herewith our own ream labels which we would like
you to include in the bales of paper to us. This is also to apply
future shipments.

In fulfilling this order and all our future purchases, you
will please instruct your Traffic Department to have all the bales
of paper for us properly marked as follows:-

Order No. 212

Bale No. 1/up
Made in Luxembourg.

"Made in Luxembourg" is necessary and should appear on the
bales, because of severe boycott movement against British and Japanese
goods in Shanghai at present. This will easily distinguish as to the
origin of merchandise shipped, as often times goods from America,
Sweden, Luxemboug and other countries are mistaken for British and
Japanese goods, with the result that same are detained, causing
troubles in the deliveries.

Your particular attention is drawn to the quality of paper
to be supplied. It should not have any dirty spotty appearance as
your sample, as this is most objectionable to the trade here, and
cause rejection of deliveries by the buyers. Please therefore give
specific instructions to the factory before manufacture, so that
there will be no complaint or rejection from the buyers.

- over -

关于：我们的进口订单第 212 号 - 100 吨
123 号未涂布新闻纸

经过双方多次电报往来，我们很高兴
能够向你们预订这批 100 吨未涂布新闻纸的初始订单，随函附上
我们的正式订单第 212 号，购买价格为每长吨（2240 磅）14 英镑 10 先令 0 便士，
成本加保险费加运费至上海，减去 2% 作为我们的佣金。

随函附上我们自己的令纸标签，希望你们
将其包含在发给我们的纸包中。这也适用于
未来的装运。

在执行此订单及我们要来的所有采购时，
请指示你们的运输部门将发给我们的所有纸包
正确标记如下：-

订单号 212

包号 1/起
卢森堡制造。

“卢森堡制造”是必要的，应出现在
纸包上，因为目前上海正盛行针对英国和日本
货物的严厉抵制运动。这将容易区分所运货物的
原产地，因为来自美国、瑞典、卢森堡和其他国家的货物经常被误认为是英国和日本货物，导致
货物被扣留，从而造成交货方面的麻烦。

请特别注意所供纸张的质量。不应像
你们的样品那样有脏斑点外观，因为这在这里的贸易中
非常令人反感，并会导致买家拒收货物。因此，请在生产前
向工厂发出具体指示，以免
买家投诉或拒收。

Dear Sirs,

To-day, we are in receipt of a copy of cable confirmation
from you pertaining to 50 tons Newspaper which, as already stated
to you per our letter No.2298 of October 12th. presumably is a
mistake.

While your price of £14. 5. 0. per ton of 2240 lbs.
c.i.f. Shanghai is workable, we nevertheless do not wish to involve
us in a transaction about which we knew nothing before, and which you
cannot confirm in case of our acceptance. However, we shall be
pleased to help you to sell this 50 tons Newspaper at £ 14. 5. 0.
if the paper is still available and can be shipped immediately.

In the event that you can accept, and shipment is made,
we will open a revocable letter of credit in your favor for drafts
to be drawn at 120 d/s.

Will you kindly cable us upon receipt of this letter,
stating if you can make or have made shipment of the paper mentioned,
so that we can make sales accordingly.

Yours very truly,
Wah-Chang Trading Corp.

OUR LETTER TO C.J.KERR

Letter No.2227                                      Shanghai, August 22nd. 1927.

Messrs. C.J. Kerr,
Poste Gare Case 51,
Luxembourg.

Dear Sirs:

        We are in receipt of your circular letter of July
30th, informing us that you are closely connected with two
Paper Mills, thusing placing your firm in a good position to
quote competitive prices at all times.

        Just at the present moment, we are particularly
interested in Newsprinting, your Quality No.123, 31" x 43"
37 lbs. per ream of 500 sheets, packed in bales of 15 reams
each. Will you please, on receipt of this letter, quote us,
by cable, your lowest possible price c.i.f. Shanghai, say for
a quantity of 100 tons for shipment in 2 equal lots during
September/October, 1927.

        As we have not done business with you before, we
would like you to cable us your bankers to whom we may apply
for information concerning the credit standing and business
integrity of your goodselves. Herewith, we wish to mention
our bankers, Messrs. Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank, Ltd.
The National City Bank of New York, Shanghai and New York and
The Guaranty Trust Co. of New York, New York City. from whom
you may apply for a similar purpose as to the standing of
our firm.

        As to terms, we will do business with you on the
basis of 90% invoice to be drawn per 90 days draft against
confirmed letter of credit opened in your favor, and balance
10% to be reimbursed to you per 30 days' sight draft to be
drawn after arrival of shipment. Kindly let us know if this
term is agreeable to you.

        Your attention is specially called to the fact that
paper business in China is done on quality basis, not to say that
the prices must be competitive. Therefore, you must see to it
that all paper shipments from you are according to samples
submitted, failing which no business will be considered by the
buyers.

        目前，我們對新聞紙特別感興趣，即你方123號品質，31英寸 x 43英寸，每令（500張）重37磅，每15令打包成一捆。收到此信後，請用電報向我方報出最低可能的成本加保險費及運費至上海價，例如100噸的數量，在1927年9月/10月期間分兩批均等裝運。

        由於我們此前未與你方做過生意，希望你方用電報告知你方的往來銀行，以便我們向其查詢你方的資信狀況和商業誠信。茲提及我方往來銀行：上海商業儲蓄銀行有限公司、紐約國家城市銀行上海分行及紐約分行、以及紐約市紐約擔保信託公司，你方可向這些銀行查詢以了解我方公司的資信狀況。

        關於條款，我們將基於以下條件與你方開展業務：憑開立以你方為受益人的保兌信用證，開立90天期匯票提取發票金額的90%，餘額10%在貨物到達後開立30天見票匯票償還給你方。請告知此條款是否為你方所接受。

        特別提請你方注意，中國的紙張業務是以質量為基礎進行的，更不用說價格必須具有競爭力。因此，你方必須確保所有從你方裝運的紙張均符合所提交的樣品，否則買方將不予考慮任何業務。

CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENT
CANTON OF VAUD
LAUSANNE, SWITZERLAND.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No I. Q. D. !!! 87）

Lausanne, March 17, 1930.

To the Chief of Police,
Shanghai, China.

Sir,

We have the honour to send you copy of a circular
relating to serious cases of fraud perpetrated during the
past few years by means of false bills of lading the author
of which, in consequence of complaints made at Lausanne,
Switzerland, has been arrested at Tournai, Belgium.

Since then our investigations have led to the
discovery of numerous other cases of fraud . We have
received information from the London Police that the
Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank of Shanghai has been
victimised through documentary credits which it had opened
with the London Branch of the Guaranty Trust Co. of New
York in favour of Sir John Kerr, 60 Boulevard de la
Petrusse, Luxemburg. This individual is none other than
Christo Carifalis, the author of numerous cases of fraud
perpetrated under different names and who has succeeded in
securing money by means of false bills of lading and false
insurance policies. Similar frauds have been perpetrated
on the Industrial and Commercial Bank of Hongkong.

We request you kindly to inform us whether
Carifalis under the name of John Kerr or L. O. Baird
or Craster or John J. Dennis or under any of the other
aliases given in our circular has been sought for in your
country.

Thanking you in advance for information,

(signed) Jaquillard,

Chief of Police,
i/c Criminal Investigation Dept.
Canton of Vaud,
Switzerland.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查科
沃州
瑞士洛桑。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查科登记簿
编号 I. Q. D. !!! 87）

洛桑，1930年3月17日。

致中国上海警察局长：

先生：

谨随函附上通缉令副本一份，该通缉令涉及过去数年间利用伪造提单实施的严重诈骗案件。鉴于在瑞士洛桑提出的投诉，该案主犯已在比利时图尔奈被捕。

此后，我们的调查发现了更多其他诈骗案件。我们从伦敦警方获悉，上海商业储蓄银行（Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank）成为受害者，该行通过纽约担保信托公司（Guaranty Trust Co. of New York）伦敦分行开立了以卢森堡佩特鲁斯大道60号约翰·克尔爵士（Sir John Kerr）为受益人的跟单信用证。此人实为克里斯托·卡里法利斯（Christo Carifalis），他曾使用不同姓名实施多起诈骗，并成功利用伪造提单和伪造保险单骗取资金。香港工商银行也遭受了类似的诈骗。

恳请贵方告知，在我国通缉令中列出的别名，如约翰·克尔（John Kerr）、L. O. 贝尔德（L. O. Baird）、克拉斯特（Craster）、约翰·J. 丹尼斯（John J. Dennis）或其他别名之下，卡里法利斯是否在贵国被通缉。

预先感谢贵方提供的情报，

（签名）雅基亚尔（Jaquillard），

警察局长，
主管刑事调查科，
瑞士沃州。

page_data.en:
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENT OF THE CANTON
OF VAUD, LAUSANNE, SWITZERLAND.

Telegraphic Address: SURETE, LAUSANNE.

------------------

Lausanne, January 9, 1930.

VERY IMPORTANT NOTICE.

Fraud involving 1,000,000 French francs
by means of false bills of lading.-------

Messrs. S. E. Kwok and Co., a Chinese firm established
at HHongkong, having accepted offers of paper pulp from
L. O. Baird, a fictitious mill proprietor of Czecho-Slovakia,
giving his address as Lausanne-Ouchy, opened documentary
credits at the Banque Franco-Chinoise for the Industrial
and Commercial Agency of Hongkong for a total of £7988
in favour of L. O. Baird. Upon L. O. Baird producing
to the Paris Branch of the Banque Franco-Chinoise the
bills of lading to show that the goods ordered by Kwok
and Co. had been dispatched by the Ostasiatiske Co. of
Oslo the Bank paid out by cheques a total of £7988 on
the security of the surrender of these documents. The
cheques were cashed at the Union of Swiss Banks at
Lausanne by Baird through the medium of one Cela de Santi,
daughter of Achille and Isabelle nee Pokorni, born on
May 8, 1882 at Venice, native of France, unmarried.

Subsequently it was ascertained that the bills
of lading were false and that the goods had never been
dispatched. It was a case of a new and very clever
method of fraud. A complaint was lodged by the Banque
Franco-Chinoise and the Magistrate of Lausanne commenced
a criminal investigation and issued warrants against:
1) the so-called L. O. Baird and
2) his accomplice Cela de Santi.

The investigations led to the arrest of Cela de
Santi, formerly known under the name of Enrici, at
Tournai, Belgium, on December 14, 1929, and of the
so-called L. O. Baird at Tournai on December 19, 1929.

Baird was identified as Christo Carifalis son
of Jean and Kotore, born on October 22, 1876 or 1877
at Ikaria, Greece, domiciled at Ikaria, a native of
Greece.

When interrogated in prison, Carifalis confessed
to having perpetrated a fraud on the Banque Franco-Chinoise
and acknowledge having cashed a sum of 200,000 Swiss francs
through the woman de Santi, according to the statement of
account of the Union of Swiss Banks.

Carifalis appears to be the same person who,
under the name of Sir John Kerr alias John J. Dennis
alias Xenophon Kallis, resided at Geneva and Lausanne
in 1926 and he very probably was the author of a fraud
perpetrated on the Societe Marseillaise de Credit at
Lausanne. On June 26, 1926 he cashed a forged cheque
for 2220.40 R.M. (?reichmarks) to the order of Frank
R. Hiller drawn by the Amsterdamsche Bank at Rotterdam
on the Darmstadter Bank at Frankfort. The affair at the
time was the subject of criminal investigation at Lausanne
and later in Holland but the offender was never discovered.
page_data.zh:
瑞士沃州洛桑刑事调查科。

电报挂号：SURETE, LAUSANNE。

------------------

洛桑，1930年1月9日。

非常重要通告。

利用伪造提单实施涉及100万法郎的诈骗案。-------

香港一家名为郭氏公司（Messrs. S. E. Kwok and Co.）的中国商号，接受了虚构的捷克斯洛伐克磨坊主 L. O. 贝尔德（L. O. Baird）提供的纸浆报价，其地址列为洛桑-乌希（Lausanne-Ouchy），遂为中港工业代理行（Industrial and Commercial Agency of Hongkong）在中法实业银行（Banque Franco-Chinoise）开立了总额为7988英镑、以 L. O. 贝尔德为受益人的跟单信用证。当 L. O. 贝尔德向中法实业银行巴黎分行出示提单，证明郭氏公司订购的货物已由奥斯陆的东亚公司（Ostasiatiske Co. of Oslo）发运后，银行凭这些单据的交付，以支票形式支付了总计7988英镑。这些支票由贝尔德通过塞拉·德·桑蒂（Cela de Santi）在洛桑的瑞士银行联合会（Union of Swiss Banks）兑现。塞拉·德·桑蒂系阿基勒（Achille）与伊莎贝尔（Isabelle，娘家姓波科尔尼 Pokorni）之女，1882年5月8日出生于威尼斯，法国籍，未婚。

随后查明，提单系伪造，货物从未发运。这是一种新颖且非常狡猾的诈骗手段。中法实业银行提出控告，洛桑地方法官启动了刑事调查，并对以下人员签发逮捕令：
1) 所谓的 L. O. 贝尔德，以及
2) 其同伙塞拉·德·桑蒂。

调查导致塞拉·德·桑蒂（曾用名恩里奇 Enrici）于1929年12月14日在比利时图尔奈被捕，所谓的 L. O. 贝尔德于1929年12月19日在图尔奈被捕。

贝尔德被确认为克里斯托·卡里法利斯（Christo Carifalis），系让（Jean）与科托雷（Kotore）之子，1876年或1877年10月22日出生于希腊伊卡里亚岛（Ikaria），寓居伊卡里亚，希腊籍。

卡里法利斯在监狱受审时，承认对中法实业银行实施了诈骗，并根据瑞士银行联合会的对账单，承认通过德·桑蒂女子兑现了20万瑞士法郎。

卡里法利斯似乎就是1926年以约翰·克尔爵士（Sir John Kerr，又名约翰·J. 丹尼斯 John J. Dennis，又名色诺芬·卡利斯 Xenophon Kallis）之名居住在日内瓦和洛桑的同一个人，他极有可能是对在洛桑的马赛信贷公司（Societe Marseillaise de Credit）实施诈骗的主犯。1926年6月26日，他兑现了一张金额为2220.40德国马克（?reichmarks）的伪造支票，收款人为弗兰克·R. 希勒（Frank R. Hiller），该支票由阿姆斯特丹银行（Amsterdamsche Bank）鹿特丹分行开具，付款行为法兰克福的达姆施塔特银行（Darmstadter Bank）。此事当时在洛桑及后来在荷兰均成为刑事调查的对象，但罪犯从未被发现。

page_data.en:
-2-

Frank R. Hiller lived at No. II Clarendon
Road, London. During a stay at Vevey in 1926 Kerr gave
his address as Lechorm Road, Harlesdem, N.W. 10.

Carifalis, who used the name of Sir John Kerr
to cash the cheque, cashed another cheque at Geneva
in March 1927 to the order of John J. Dennis endorsed
in blank by the latter. The relation between Kerr
and Dennis is thus established. On the other hand,
Dennis, who is the holder of post office box No. 357 at
the Rive Post Office, Geneva, caused his mail to be
forwarded to the address of Kallis (Post Office Box
Jordils, Lausanne, No. 17613). The wife of de Santi
acknowledged that Baird and Kallis----and consequently
Kerr and Dennis----were one and the same person and
this our investigations have confirmed.

Carifalis appears to be also the same person
as Walther H. Knopper, notified in the Swiss Police
Gazette Article No. 8834 in 1925 by the Police
Department of Bale for a serious case of swindling
perpetrated on Messrs. J. Menasce Fils. of Cairo
and on the Banque d'Industrie at Athens.

At the time of arrest Carifalis was in possession
of the following articles:-
1) A British passport in the name of Charles
Hunter Knox, British, born on July 10, 1877.
2) A British passport in the name of John
Craster, British, born on March 12, 1877.

The following articles were found in a luggage
depot at the Hotel Terminus, Paris:-

3) A British passport in the name of John
Stewart Todd, born on May 19, 1879.
4) A passport, which appears to be genuine, in
the name of Christo Carifalis, Greek.

Carifalis also made use of the following name:
Charles Bellot, No. 19 Aldine Street. He had amongst
his papers a letter-head bearing this name and on which
his profession is given as Solicitor.

Investigations conducted by the London Police
revealed that a boarding house is being maintained at
this address and according to what could be verified
Cela de Santi is known there. She had commissioned the
proprietress of the boarding house to receive all mails
addressed to Bellot and to forward them to the address
of J. A. Craster at Lausanne, Box St. Francis in
envelopes prepared for this purpose.

Later Mrs. Butler whom the London Police describe
as an honest woman but a little simple was informed that
letters addressed to L. O. Baird would reach her and
that she was to hand them to a Mr. Hudson who would call
for them and who in fact did call for them.

Christo Carifalis alias Craster etc. claims to
have an accomplice named Black or Blak residing at this
boarding house who had furnished the false bills of lading
and the false papers of identification. His statements
on this point are rather evasive. Investigations are
proceeding to ascertain whether such a person really
exists or whether he is Carifalis himself. In the
note-book of addresses belonging to Carifalis occurs the
following entry: W. H. Blake, No. 2 Catherine Street,
Dundee, Scotland. This man may have been the accomplice.
page_data.zh:
-2-

弗兰克·R. 希勒居住在伦敦克拉伦登路11号（No. II Clarendon Road）。1926年在沃韦（Vevey）停留期间，克尔给出的地址是哈勒斯登西北10区莱乔姆路（Lechorm Road, Harlesdem, N.W. 10）。

卡里法利斯使用约翰·克尔的名字兑现支票，又于1927年3月在日内瓦兑现了另一张收款人为约翰·J. 丹尼斯的支票，该支票由后者空白背书。由此确立了克尔与丹尼斯之间的关系。另一方面，丹尼斯拥有日内瓦里夫邮局（Rive Post Office）第357号信箱，他要求将其邮件转寄至卡利斯的地址（洛桑约尔迪尔邮局 Jordils Post Office, Lausanne，第17613号信箱）。德·桑蒂的妻子承认，贝尔德和卡利斯——因此也就是克尔和丹尼斯——是同一个人，我们的调查也证实了这一点。

卡里法利斯似乎也是瓦尔特·H. 克诺珀（Walther H. Knopper），巴塞尔警察局曾于1925年在《瑞士警察公报》第8834条中通报此人，因其对开罗的 J. 梅纳斯切父子商行（Messrs. J. Menasce Fils.）和雅典工业银行（Banque d'Industrie at Athens）实施了严重诈骗。

卡里法利斯被捕时持有以下物品：
1) 一本以查尔斯·亨特·诺克斯（Charles Hunter Knox）为名的英国护照，英国人，1877年7月10日出生。
2) 一本以约翰·克拉斯特（John Craster）为名的英国护照，英国人，1877年3月12日出生。

在巴黎终点酒店（Hotel Terminus）的行李寄存处发现了以下物品：

3) 一本以约翰·斯图尔特·托德（John Stewart Todd）为名的护照，1879年5月19日出生。
4) 一本看似真实的以克里斯托·卡里法利斯为名的希腊护照。

卡里法利斯还使用了以下名字：查尔斯·贝洛特（Charles Bellot），阿尔丁街19号（No. 19 Aldine Street）。在他的文件中有一张印有此名字的信头，上面注明其职业为律师（Solicitor）。

伦敦警方进行的调查显示，该地址经营着一家寄宿公寓，经核实，塞拉·德·桑蒂在那里为人所知。她委托寄宿公寓的女主人接收所有寄给贝洛特的邮件，并用为此准备好的信封将其转寄至洛桑圣弗朗西斯信箱（Box St. Francis）的 J. A. 克拉斯特地址。

后来，伦敦警方描述为诚实但有点单纯的一位巴特勒夫人（Mrs. Butler）被告知，寄给 L. O. 贝尔德的信件会送到她那里，她需将这些信件交给一位哈德森先生（Mr. Hudson），后者会上门取件，事实上他也确实这样做了。

克里斯托·卡里法利斯（又名克拉斯特等）声称有一名名叫布莱克（Black）或布拉克（Blak）的同伙居住在这家寄宿公寓，此人提供了伪造的提单和伪造的身份文件。他在此问题上的陈述相当含糊。调查正在进行中，以确定此人是否真实存在，或者他就是卡里法利斯本人。在卡里法利斯的地址记事本中，有以下条目：W. H. 布莱克（W. H. Blake），苏格兰邓迪凯瑟琳街2号（No. 2 Catherine Street, Dundee, Scotland）。此人可能是同伙。

page_data.en:
-3-

The false documents in the affair of the Banque
Franco-Chinoise were sent by Black to Evian, Postal Box D.
At the time when he cashed the cheques between March, 1929
and November, 1929 Carifalis was living at the Villa Les
Genets, Avenue de la Grande Rive at Evian.

We also noted the names of Knogen and Collins employed
by Carifalis or one of his accomplices when he perpetrated
a swindle under the name of Knopper on Messrs. J. Menasce
of Cairo and on the Banque d'Industrie of Athens. The
following also appeared in his notes: C. Enrici; C. de
Santi, No. 58a Sinclair Road, W. 14. This address was
still that of A. C. Leake-Dawson according to the
note-book of Carifalis and later that of H. Dale-Dawson
according to the printed letter paper and envelopes found
at the home of Carifalis and inscribed as follows:-

H. Dale Dawson,                     86a Sinclair Road,
Exporter.                           London, W. 14.

Carifalis is, without doubt, the author of other
cases of fraud. The investigations have revealed so far
that he has been in correspondence recently with
especially Japan and the following addresses of firms
to which he has made offers of paper etc. have been found:-

The Sumitomo Bank, Ltd., Osaka, Japan.
Sugiyama Co., Ltd. Kiomachibori 2, Osaka.
Jinfound Trading Co.
Hattory Trading Co., Ltd., Ginza Nichome, Tokyo.

One of his principal methods consists of having
a temporary lodging place in various cities throughout
Europe. In this manner, he had false luggage and false
passports to Lille, France, to Metz, Alsace, to Paris etc.
as well as letter boxes at numerous addresses whence
his letters are re-forwarded to his various assumed names.
At the address of Charles Bellot who lives at the
Butler boarding house, 19 Aldine Street, London, we found:

One post box in the name of Craster, St. Francis
Post Office, Lausanne.
One post box No. 17350 in the name of Baird,
Jordils Post Office, Lausanne.
One post box No. 631 in the name of Craster at
Brussels, Belgium.
One address in the name of de Santi, Hotel de
Paris, Tournai.
One box at Paris, Bureau Poste No. 31.
One address R. C., Poste Restante, Prague.
One post box in the name of Baird at Evian.

Besides these there are the old boxes of 1926-1927
in the name of Dennis, Box No. 357 Rive Post Office,
Geneva, and in the name of Kallis, Box No. 17613 Jordils
Post Office at Lausanne. It is probable there are
others and investigations will be made with the object of
determining their existence.

The role played by the woman de Santi appeared to
have been as follows:- At times she is employed by Baird
to secure letters arriving at certain post boxes, and
at other times she is detailed to withdraw the greater
part of funds from the Union of Swiss Banks at Lausanne.

Notifications relating to Carifalis have been issued
as follows:-

On July II, 1925 in article No. 8834 of the Swiss
Police Gazette on Christo Carifalis and Walther H.

中法实业银行案件中的伪造文件是由布莱克寄往埃维昂（Evian）邮政D号信箱的。在1929年3月至1929年11月间兑现支票时，卡里法利斯居住在埃维昂大滨河大道（Avenue de la Grande Rive）的莱热内别墅（Villa Les Genets）。

我们还注意到，卡里法利斯或其一名同伙在以克诺珀之名对开罗的 J. 梅纳斯切商行和雅典工业银行实施诈骗时，使用了克诺根（Knogen）和柯林斯（Collins）的名字。他的笔记中还出现了以下内容：C. 恩里奇（C. Enrici）；C. 德·桑蒂（C. de Santi），辛克莱路58a号，西14区（No. 58a Sinclair Road, W. 14）。根据卡里法利的记事本，该地址此前属于 A. C. 利克-道森（A. C. Leake-Dawson），后来根据在卡里法利斯家中发现的印刷信纸和信封显示，属于 H. 戴尔-道森（H. Dale-Dawson），信封上 inscription 如下：

H. 戴尔·道森，                     辛克莱路86a号，
出口商。                           伦敦，西14区。

毫无疑问，卡里法利斯是其他诈骗案件的主犯。迄今为止的调查表明，他最近尤其与日本有通信往来，并发现了他向其提供纸张等货物的以下公司地址：

日本大阪住友银行有限公司（The Sumitomo Bank, Ltd., Osaka, Japan）。
大阪清町堀2号杉山有限公司（Sugiyama Co., Ltd. Kiomachibori 2, Osaka）。
金丰贸易公司（Jinfound Trading Co.）。
东京银座二丁目服部贸易有限公司（Hattory Trading Co., Ltd., Ginza Nichome, Tokyo）。

他的主要手法之一是在欧洲各城市设立临时住所。通过这种方式，他拥有发往法国里尔、阿尔萨斯梅斯、巴黎等地的伪造行李和伪造护照，以及在多个地址设立的信箱，从这些信箱他的信件被重新转发给他的各个化名。在居住在伦敦阿尔丁街19号巴特勒寄宿公寓的查尔斯·贝洛特的地址下，我们发现了：

一个以克拉斯特为名，位于洛桑圣弗朗西斯邮局的信箱。
一个以贝尔德为名，位于洛桑约尔迪尔邮局的第17350号信箱。
一个以克拉斯特为名，位于比利时布鲁塞尔的第631号信箱。
一个以德·桑蒂为名，位于图尔奈巴黎酒店（Hotel de Paris）的地址。
一个位于巴黎第31号邮政局的信箱。
一个布拉格留局待取（Poste Restante）的 R. C. 地址。
一个以贝尔德为名，位于埃维昂的信箱。

除此之外，还有1926-1927年间以丹尼斯为名，位于日内瓦里夫邮局的第357号信箱，以及以卡利斯为名，位于洛桑约尔迪尔邮局的第17613号信箱。可能还有其他信箱，我们将进行调查以确定其存在。

德·桑蒂女子所扮演的角色似乎如下：有时她受贝尔德雇佣，去获取到达某些信箱的信件；有时她被指派从洛桑的瑞士银行联合会提取大部分资金。

关于卡里法利斯的通报发布情况如下：

1925年7月11日，在《瑞士警察公报》第8834条中，关于克里斯托·卡里法利斯和瓦尔特·H.

Knopper bythe Police Department of Bale. The article
states that Carifalis is under a warrant of arrest of the
"Landgericht" of Hamburg. According to information
received from the French Criminal Investigation
Department the affair related to a case of fraud
involving 800,000 marks.
2) On November 6, 1925 in article No. II093 of
notifications from Belgium, Christo Carifalis is
mentioned as having been sentenced to seven months
imprisonment plus one month for fraud and for using
a false name.
3) On January 31, 1926 according to notifications
from Germany, Carifalis was wanted on a warrant issued
by Magistrate 7 of Hamburg.

According to information furnished by the French
Criminal Investigation Department when Carifalis
committed a fraud on a firm in Hamburg he was
accompanied by Darlymple, his secretary. At the time of
his arrest at Tournai, Carifalis was in possession of a
receipt issued by the Midland Bank, Ltd., No. 60
Gracechurch Street, London, also in the name of
Darlymple. An investigation was actively commenced to
identify the individual in order to ascertain his
connection with Carifalis.

With the probable object of concealing his funds,
Carifalis had cash deposits in numerous banks amongst
which were the following:-

At the Swiss Bank Corporation, London, No. 99
Gresham Street, about £4600. This money has been
transferred on an order issued by Carifalis from his
prison at Tournai to Messrs. Leader, Plunkett and Leader,
solicitors, No. 49 Newgate Street, London.
At the Banque d'Alsace and de Lorraine, a sum of
235,000 French francs. This money has been sequestrated.
At the Lloyd's National and Provincial Bank, No. 43
Boulevard des Capucines at Paris where a sum of francs 2320
is on deposit in the name of Mrs. Carifalis.
At the London Branch of the Lloyd's National and
Provincial Bank, Lombard Street, where there is a deposit
also in the name of Mrs. Carifalis.
At the Credit Commercial de France, 103 Avenue des
Champs Elysees, a deposit of francs 18,000 in the name
of C. Carifalis.
At the Societe Francais, Brussels, an account in
the name of Craster.
At the Midland Bank, Ltd., Gracechurch Street, a
deposit in the name of Darlymple, 52 Jeffreys Road.
At the Societe de Banque Suisse at Lausanne, a
deposit of 20,000 Swiss francs in the name of Mrs.
Carifalis and another of 1500 Swiss francs in the name of
C. Carifalis were sequestrated.

Carifalis had dealings with other banks, especially
the Banque d'Outremer, Brussels, the Banque Belge Pour
l'Etranger, No. 4 Bishops-gate, E.C. 2, the Banque Federal
at Lausanne and investigations are being made to
ascertain whether there are deposits in any of these
banks. An investigation is also being made to ascertain
whether the fraud committed under the various aliases
had resulted in any transactions with other banks and
whether there are deposits of funds or securities.
Such funds and securities will also be sequestrated.

Little is known of the former life history of
Carifalis. He declares that he was formerly a paper
merchant with offices at No. 3 Tudor Street, London.
Information may be sought at this address which he has

由巴勒（Bale）警察局提供的关于克诺珀（Knopper）的信息。文章指出，卡里法利斯（Carifalis）持有汉堡“地方法院”（Landgericht）签发的逮捕令。根据从法国刑事调查局获得的信息，此事涉及一桩金额为80万马克的欺诈案。
2) 在1925年11月6日比利时通报的第II093号文章中，克里斯托·卡里法利斯（Christo Carifalis）被提及因欺诈和使用假名被判处七个月监禁，外加一个月刑期。
3) 根据1926年1月31日来自德国的通报，卡里法利斯因汉堡第7号治安法官签发的逮捕令而被通缉。

根据法国刑事调查局提供的信息，当卡里法利斯对汉堡的一家公司实施欺诈时，其秘书达林普尔（Darlymple）随行。在图尔奈（Tournai）被捕时，卡里法利斯持有一张由伦敦格雷彻奇街60号米德兰银行有限公司（Midland Bank, Ltd.）开具的收据，该收据也是以达林普尔的名义出具的。已积极展开调查以确认此人身份，并查明其与卡里法利斯的关系。

为了可能隐藏其资金，卡里法利斯在多家银行存有现金存款，其中包括以下银行：

在伦敦格雷舍姆街99号的瑞士银行公司（Swiss Bank Corporation），约有4600英镑。这笔钱已根据卡里法利斯从图尔奈监狱发出的指令，转账至伦敦纽盖特街49号的律师行——利德、普伦基特和利德律师事务所（Messrs. Leader, Plunkett and Leader）。
在阿尔萨斯和洛林银行（Banque d'Alsace and de Lorraine），存有235,000法郎。这笔钱已被扣押。
在巴黎卡普辛大道43号的劳埃德国家与地方银行（Lloyd's National and Provincial Bank），以卡里法利斯夫人的名义存有2320法郎。
在伦巴第街的劳埃德国家与地方银行伦敦分行，也有一笔以卡里法利斯夫人名义的存款。
在香榭丽舍大街103号的法国商业信贷银行（Credit Commercial de France），以C. 卡里法利斯的名义存有18,000法郎。
在布鲁塞尔的法国银行协会（Societe Francais），有一个以克雷斯特（Craster）为名的账户。
在格雷彻奇街的米德兰银行有限公司，有一笔以达林普尔名义、地址为杰弗里斯路52号的存款。
在洛桑的瑞士银行协会（Societe de Banque Suisse），以卡里法利斯夫人名义存的20,000瑞士法郎和以C. 卡里法利斯名义存的1,500瑞士法郎均已被扣押。

卡里法利斯与其他银行也有往来，特别是布鲁塞尔的海外银行（Banque d'Outremer）、位于主教门4号、E.C. 2区的比利时外国银行（Banque Belge Pour l'Etranger）以及洛桑的联邦银行（Banque Federal），目前正在调查这些银行中是否有存款。同时也在调查使用各种别名实施的欺诈是否导致与其他银行发生交易，以及是否有资金或证券存款。此类资金和证券也将被扣押。

人们对卡里法利斯以前的生平知之甚少。他声称以前是一名纸张商人，办公室位于伦敦都铎街3号。可以向该地址以及他曾居住过的士麦那（Smyrna）的惠特尔公司（firm of Whitall）查询信息。他说他有四个儿子：莱奥尼达斯（Leonidas）在伦敦（经济学院），普拉顿（Platon）在巴黎度假，让（Jean）和西奥多（Theodore）目前与母亲一起在希腊。根据1926年比利时通报第11094条，我们得知西奥多·卡里法利斯于1904年10月28日出生在亚历山大港。有一次，他与其父因欺诈和使用假护照被判处七个月监禁。关于这些人，特别是关于西奥多·卡里法利斯停留地点的任何信息都将证明是有用的，因为随后可能会确立他在本案中的共犯关系。
    谨请收到本通函的瑞士及各国警察局长积极开展调查，目的是查明卡里法利斯是谁，他的同伙以及与他有关系的人是谁，他是否犯有其他罪行，以及除了上述提到的信箱外，他是否还有其他信箱。

    亦请收到本通函的各银行进行调查，目的是查明卡里法利斯是否在附录名单中的任何名下，或其家庭成员名下，有任何存款、账户或保险箱寄存物。

Lausanne, le 9 Janvier 1930

Avis très important.
====================

Escroquerie d'un million de francs français à l'aide de
faux connaissements.
--------------------------------------------

La maison S.E. KNOCK & Cie, firme chinoise établie
à Hongkong, ayant accepté les offres de pâte de papier qui
lui avaient été faites par un soi-disant L.C. BAIRD, préten-
dument propriétaire de fabriques en Tchéco-Slovaquie, et
donnant comme adresse Case Lausanne-Luchy, a ouvert au dit
Baird des crédits documentaires pour un total de Est. 7.980.-
à la Banque Franco-Chinoise pour le Commerce et l'Industrie
Agence de Hongkong. Le s/d. L.C. Baird ayant produit à la
Banque Franco-Chinoise, siège de Paris, des connaissements
établissant que la marchandise commandée par la maison
KNOCK avait été expédiée, par l'intermédiaire de l'Ostasiatiska
Compagnie à Oslo, la dite banque a payé en couverture de ces
remises documentaires le montant total de 7.980 Livres ster-
ling, par des chèques successifs encaissés à Lausanne, à
l'Union de Banques Suisses, par Baird, par l'intermédiaire
d'une nommée DE SANTI Cela, fille d'Achille et d'Isabelle
née Pozorni, née le 8 Mai 1892 à Venise, d'origine française,
célibataire.

Dès lors, il a été établi que les actes de con-
naissement constituaient des faux et que la marchandise n'a-
vait jamais été expédiée à son destinataire. Il s'agit dans
le cas particulier d'un procédé nouveau et fort habile d'es-
croquerie.

Plainte a été déposée par la Banque Franco-Chinoise
et le Juge informateur de Lausanne a ouvert une instruction
pénale et décerné des mandats d'arrêt contre :
1/ le soi-disant L.C. BAIRD,
2/ sa complice De SANTI Cela .
